question: Can an optional appearance-confirmation branch recover excluded low-confidence detections using a complete competitive row pool without changing native thresholds or assigned active identities?
problem: The true current continuation for574 exists among cached detections but both observations have confidence below native low threshold. Recovering a pair cannot be called a public-ID fix: the old falseproposal was already globallyblocked.
engineering_scope: Five previously examined cases and222 raw current-car detections; selected with known earlier outcomes. This is an engineering check, not heldout generalization.
bank_binding: Parent must register descriptor_binding.json with exact bank SHA256 and extraction execution/protocol hashes BEFORE GO and repair outcomes. Bank keys match extraction-plan video|frame; each array is boxes-by256. All5 original target references reused exactly; all107 row references available.

decision_inputs.rows: Only tid,state,cls,predicted_xyxy from all107 saved first-stage rows.
decision_inputs.candidates: Only raw_id,box,confidence,cls for all222 raw class2 detections; no GT labels, old_case or special IDs.
decision_inputs.memory: MASA descriptors of actual prior observed reference boxes. Reference rawframe strictly before currentframe. All competing rows included.
decision_inputs.ownership: Freeze ALL snapshot.assigned public (tid,raw_id), including later native stages/new tracks, not just first Hungarian pairs.

policy.candidate_aliases: Confidence-priority class-specific greedy NMS; suppress only IoU>0.7, representative highest confidence then raw_id tie ordering, preserve every alias. NMS is truth-free and not an identity grouping.
policy.appearance: Borrow unchanged project BoT-SORT appearance_thresh=0.8 with exact source semantics cost=(1-cosine)/2 <=1-0.8, equivalent cosine about0.6. This is explicitly a borrowed hypothesis, not a calibrated MASA probability.
policy.proximity: Borrow unchanged project BoT-SORT proximity_thresh=0.5: representative box IoU with actual saved predicted_xyxy >=0.5.
policy.low_only: Only representative confidence<=native track_low_thresh0.1 may enter optional recovery. Native high0.25/low0.1 unchanged; no new tracks started.
policy.competition: Require unique forward best appearance group among ALL raw groups and unique reverse best row among ALL complete reference rows, same class. No new margin threshold. Exact score tie=>defer.
policy.continue: Native-unassigned tracked/lost row; best group excluded low, passes both absolute gates, strictly mutual and no alias has a frozen native owner. Emit separate proposal, never mutate tracker.
policy.defer: Preserve native assignment, missing reference competition/descriptors, tied or nonmutual best, occupied alias or best group belongs to native candidate branch.
policy.refuse: No raw candidate, or no excluded-low candidate passes fixed absolute appearance and proximity gates. Top1 by itself is never an absence detector.
policy.insertion_cost: appearance_cost=(1-cosine)/2; parent adapter may solve unmatched rows vs newlow columns with0.2 sourcegate, freezing saved assignments. Proposal is not public output or lifecycle replay.
